resources.string: Share workout data with AI engines
Lets the AI planners see your recent weights and suggest a working weight. Off by default.
Follow an active scheduled workout one set at a time. Off by default; manual logging stays available.
Used when an exercise has no saved rest override. Goal-based ranges are guidance only.

Optional local notifications for live guided rest prompts. Precise timing uses Android’s Alarms & reminders access. Power restrictions can still delay alerts; pop-up banners depend on notification settings. This is not a recovery measurement.
Alerts may arrive late. Allow precise timing to reduce scheduling delays; alerts remain enabled without it.
Notifications are blocked. The rest countdown still works; allow notifications in system settings to enable alerts.
Background rest alerts are currently available on Android only.
Optional guidance after two consecutive live same-exercise intervals shorter than your chosen rest time. It never changes your workout.
Shows the time left in a silent ongoing notification while a rest countdown runs, so you can check it without opening HydraFit. Off by default.
Notifications are blocked. Allow notifications in system settings to show the rest countdown notification.
Shows a brief “Rest complete” message and one short vibration when a rest countdown ends while HydraFit is open. Off by default.
One notification on days when your active block has a workout planned, at a local time you choose. It never starts or logs a workout, and delivery may be late.
Notifications are blocked, so reminders can’t appear. Allow notifications in system settings, then switch reminders on again.
Workout reminders are currently available on Android only.
Skips the reminder when your chosen time falls inside this window instead of postponing it.
Add a Gemini API key to enable the cloud engine.
On-device planning can take several minutes, depending on your phone’s processor.
A key is saved on this device.
Import a .litertlm model to enable the on-device engine.

Not enough free storage to import the model. Remove the current model or free up space, then try again.

NPU model packs aren’t supported in this build. Import the standard Gemma 3 1B (CPU/GPU) pack instead.

Save your supported data to a local file, or replace it from a backup. API keys and the on-device model aren’t included.
Saves your recorded training history as a CSV for analysis in another tool. Your personal notes are not included, and this is not a backup — the file can’t be restored into HydraFit.
Backup and restore aren’t available on this platform yet.
Restore staged. Close and reopen HydraFit to apply it.
